candidates.title: Elastic Memory Remapping for Multi-tenant LLM Serving
candidates.reason: Oneiros is a serving-runtime memory-management design that remaps immutable model-parameter memory into KV-cache capacity instead of swapping KV cache, directly matching the repository's KV-memory, offload, and multi-tenant serving lineages.

candidates.title: Scaling Attention Beyond GPUs for LLM Inference
candidates.reason: Beyond is a drop-in hybrid CPU-GPU attention runtime for oversized KV caches, combining selective KV retention, CPU-resident sparse attention, and minimal PCIe movement; this is a direct fit for offload and hierarchical-memory inference.

candidates.title: Talaria: Session-Aware Serverless Serving of Hundred-Billion-Parameter LLMs
candidates.reason: Talaria jointly optimizes model residency, KV locality, admission, host-restorable KV, and weight staging for multi-model LLM serving; it directly extends serving, scheduling, and memory-management lineages.

candidates.title: [AAFLOW+] Stateful Operator Abstraction with Zero-Copy Distributed KV Cache Orchestration for Multi-Agent Workflows
candidates.reason: AAFLOW+ treats distributed KV cache as a first-class systems object with materialization, transfer, fork, composition, eviction, and zero-copy execution, making it directly relevant to KV reuse and distributed inference systems.

candidates.title: Transition-Aware Backend Dispatch for Edge LLM Inference
candidates.reason: This paper studies measured operator-level dispatch across CPU, CUDA, and ONNX Runtime on Jetson while explicitly accounting for backend-transition costs, fitting edge/on-device inference and heterogeneous execution.
